units.source_text: 它屹立在我和我所志向的人生之间阻挡着我，

en.t: It stood between me and the life I aspired to, blocking my way,

units.source_text: 起初它像是一幅工笔画，精致小巧，

en.t: at first like a finely detailed painting, delicate and small,
but before my eyes it gradually grew larger,

units.source_text: 在它那纤巧的模型里，仿佛能看到几乎包容整个世界的巨大金阔的呼应，

en.t: and within that exquisite model, one seemed able to see the vast golden resonance of something that almost embraced the entire world,

units.source_text: 它甚至掩埋着我四周的世界的每个角落，把这个世界的空间都完全填满。

en.t: it even buried every corner of the world around me, completely filling all the space of that world.

units.source_text: 它像巨型的音乐充满世界，

en.t: It filled the world like immense music,

units.source_text: 惟有用这种音乐才能使世界成为充满意义的东西。

en.t: and only through such music could the world become something filled with meaning.

units.source_text: 有时候，我觉得金阁竟那样地疏远我，屹立在我之外，

en.t: At times, I felt the Golden Pavilion was so strangely distant from me, standing outside me,

units.source_text: 现在却又完全包围我，允许我在其结构内部占有我的位置。

en.t: yet now it completely surrounded me, allowing me to occupy my own place inside its structure.
